site.title: AI-DLC Exercises
site.tagline: Working sessions for FTC teams — build something real, and learn how to build it with AI without handing over the thinking.
site.footer: Answers you type into a worksheet are saved in your own browser only. Nothing is uploaded, and clearing your browser data clears them.

exercises.title: Give the Arm Something New to Do
exercises.blurb: The arm is already built. Decide what it should be able to do that it can't yet, and take that objective through all five phases of AI-DLC until it works on the bench.
